en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial factory complex surrounded by dense forested hills. The main building is a multi‑storey modernist structure with long horizontal rows of windows and a tall smokestack. Several cars and smaller buildings are visible in the courtyard in front. There is a pink discoloration or mark over part of the trees on the right side. Caption text is printed along the bottom margin.
